full_prompt_en: A square painterly garden portrait shows a young woman seated in a pale floral dress, with deep green shade and sunlit stone behind her. The upper background is a broad dark area of foliage, broken by loose orange and yellow flowers near the right side. A pale stone planter or low garden structure curves across the middle distance, its cool blue violet shadows separating the woman from the surrounding greenery. The woman sits slightly left of center and fills most of the frame from her white hat to her crossed knees. Her head turns toward the right, and her eyes are lowered as she rests her chin lightly on one hand. Brown hair curls from under the wide white brim; a soft cluster of pale decoration sits at the back of the hat. Her face holds warm peach and rose tones, with the lips a small bright red accent against the quieter skin colors. The short-sleeved dress is light cream with scattered yellow orange blossoms and green leaves. Its V-shaped neckline and folds are suggested by confident broken strokes rather than sharply outlined fabric. One arm supports the chin while the other crosses her lap, its hand extending loosely above the knee. The lower right carries a broad lavender-gray plane of stone beside her legs, and a few bright marks along its edge pick up the light. Brush strokes remain visible in the dark foliage, the fabric and the stone: broad patches build the background, while shorter, more precise touches shape the eyes, fingers and floral pattern. Daylight enters from the upper left and front, striking the hat, shoulders, exposed arms and upper folds of the dress; the green background and underside of the planter stay cooler and darker. The shadows are softly colored rather than black, allowing warm skin, pale cloth and violet stone to remain connected. The overall composition pairs a quiet seated pose with loose, luminous brushwork and a warm cream palette set against deep garden greens.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、笔触鲜明的花园肖像描绘一位穿浅色花裙的年轻女子坐着，身后是深绿阴影与日照石面。上方背景是大块深色枝叶，右侧附近有松散的橙黄花朵打破暗色。一道浅色石质花盆或矮园林构件横过中景，其冷蓝紫色阴影把女子与周围绿意隔开。女子略坐在中央偏左，从白帽到交叠的膝盖占满画面大部分。她的头转向右侧，眼睛低垂，一只手轻轻托着下巴。棕发从宽大的白色帽檐下卷出，帽后有一团柔和的浅色装饰。她的面部带暖桃色与玫瑰色，嘴唇是较安静肤色中的一点明亮红色。短袖连衣裙为浅奶油色，散布黄橙色小花和绿叶。V形领口与褶皱由自信而断续的笔触提示，而非用锐利轮廓勾画。托腮的手臂之外，另一只手臂横过腿上，手在膝盖上方松弛地伸出。右下方是一大片腿旁的薰衣草灰石面，边缘几个亮笔痕接住光。深绿枝叶、衣料与石面都保留可见笔触：宽阔色块搭起背景，较短而准确的笔触刻画眼睛、手指和花纹。日光从左上与正前方进入，照亮帽子、肩膀、裸露手臂与裙子上部褶皱；绿色背景和石质构件下侧保持更冷、更暗。阴影带着柔和色彩而非黑色，使暖肤色、浅衣料与紫色石面彼此相连。整体构图以安静的坐姿配合松动而明亮的笔触，在深花园绿中衬出暖奶油色调。
style_prompt_en: The image has a luminous oil-painting character, with visible broken strokes replacing uniform blends. Broad cool green and blue violet passages surround smaller warm cream, peach and orange accents, so the bright areas feel embedded in shade. Large background shapes are loosely resolved, while focal contours become firmer through short, directional touches. Light falls from an upper frontal side and gathers on exposed planes, leaving colored blue and violet shadows instead of flat black recesses. Brush marks change scale with attention: wider sweeps carry depth and atmosphere, and fine strokes clarify selected edges and surface patterns. The space is shallow but breathable, organized by a few overlapping bands and generous dark masses. The overall effect is sunlit and contemplative, with warm and cool color patches making form more than hard outlines do.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有明亮的油画性格，以可见的断续笔触替代均一晕染。大片冷绿和蓝紫色区域围住较小的暖奶油色、桃色与橙色强调，让亮区像嵌在阴影之中。背景大形松散概括，焦点轮廓则由短而有方向性的笔触变得坚实。光从上方偏正面的方向落下，聚在受光平面，留下带蓝紫色的阴影，而非平板黑色凹处。笔痕尺度随注意力变化：宽笔势承载纵深与空气感，细笔触澄清所选边缘及表面花纹。空间较浅却通透，由几个重叠带状区域与宽大的深色块组织。整体效果有日照感且宁静，冷暖色斑比硬轮廓更主要地塑造形体。
theme_en: A woman in a pale floral dress and white hat seated in a sunlit garden
theme_zh: 一位穿浅色花裙、戴白帽的女子坐在阳光花园里
name: Vladimir Volegov
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
